changes: Fixes Library sidebar badges not populating at application startup until an Automation section was opened.
Adds a lightweight Automation sidebar-count endpoint so TV, Movies, and Wanted navigation badges can load independently of the full Automation summary and provider/newsgroup startup.
Caches the last positive Automation navigation counts, keeps startup retries bounded, and prevents transient empty snapshots from erasing valid sidebar counts while startup settles.
Restores missing Quality Profile and Newznab Indexer editor handlers that could abort app.js top-level execution before initializeApp() ran.
Adds Settings > Storage & Cache > Clear preview cache, clearing only full-preview cache files and browser preview memory while leaving thumbnails and user data intact.
Corrects the high-contrast sidebar badge CSS so the hidden state wins until real non-zero counts are available.
regression_guards: v3.6.2 Tray Upgrade Lock Reliability remains preserved.
v3.6.1 Installer Upgrade Reliability service-stop fix remains preserved.
v3.5.52 Authoritative Service Runtime Handoff remains preserved.
Private SAB downloads, Smart Import, Automation behavior, Discover/TMDB integration, provider state, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility remain unchanged.
name: Automation Sidebar Startup & Cache Reliability
